# Masroof API

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/quality/gen-api-docs.py from contracts/openapi.yaml. Do not edit; run `make docs-api`. -->

Masroof API (version 0.1.0)

**Contract-first.** This file is the single source of truth for the Masroof backend API.
Spring server interfaces, the TypeScript (PWA) client and the Kotlin (Android) client are
generated from it; generated code is never hand-edited. Breaking changes are gated by
`scripts/quality/oasdiff.sh` and require an ADR (see `docs/adr/0001-contract-first-openapi.md`).

## Conventions
- JSON bodies use `camelCase`.
- **Money is never a float.** Every monetary value is a `Money` object: integer minor units
  (piastres for EGP, cents for USD) plus an ISO-4217 currency code.
- All timestamps are RFC 3339 `date-time` in UTC; calendar dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` interpreted in
  the household timezone (`Africa/Cairo` by default).
- Every 4xx/5xx response is an RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` document (`Problem`).
- Collections are paginated with an opaque cursor: `{ items, nextCursor }`.
- IDs are UUIDs. Everything is scoped to the caller's household.
- `x-req` on an operation lists the requirement IDs (S11) it realises.

### `GET /health` - Health and build information

- operationId: `getHealth`
- Requirements: REQ-OPS-020
- Auth: none

| 200 | Service and database are up. | application/json: `Health` |
| 429 | Rate limited. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 503 | Service is not ready. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

## Auth

### `POST /auth/login` - Log in with email and password

### `POST /auth/refresh` - Rotate the refresh token

- operationId: `refreshToken`
- Requirements: REQ-SEC-001
- Auth: none

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new token pair. The old refresh token is revoked (rotation); reuse of a rotated token revokes the whole family.

Request body (`application/json`): `RefreshRequest`

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | New token pair. | application/json: `TokenPair` |
| 400 | Malformed request or validation failure. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

### `POST /auth/logout` - Log out

- operationId: `logout`

Revokes the presented refresh token's session (or all sessions of its user). Holding the refresh token is proof enough, so the bearer is optional and may be expired; unknown or already revoked tokens still give 204.

Request body (`application/json`): `LogoutRequest`

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 204 | Logged out. |  |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

## Ingest

Device ingestion endpoints (SMS, push notifications, receipts, free text). Authenticated with a per-device token.

### `POST /api/ingest/sms` - Ingest a bank/wallet SMS

- operationId: `ingestSms`
- Requirements: REQ-SMS-001, REQ-IOS-001

Used by the Android app and the iOS Shortcut. Idempotent on `(deviceId, smsId)`.
OTP messages must be dropped on-device and are rejected server-side as a second line of defence.
The server answers `202` as soon as the raw message is persisted; parsing is asynchronous.

Request body (`application/json`): `IngestSmsRequest`

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | Raw message persisted; parsing continues asynchronously. | application/json: `IngestAccepted` |
| 400 | Malformed request or validation failure. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 413 | Body exceeds the configured size limit. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 429 | Rate limited. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

### `POST /api/ingest/notification` - Ingest a bank-app push notification

- operationId: `ingestNotification`
- Requirements: REQ-NTF-001

From the Android `NotificationListenerService`. Idempotent on `(deviceId, notificationKey)`.

Request body (`application/json`): `IngestNotificationRequest`

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | Raw message persisted; parsing continues asynchronously. | application/json: `IngestAccepted` |
| 400 | Malformed request or validation failure. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 413 | Body exceeds the configured size limit. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 429 | Rate limited. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

### `POST /api/ingest/receipt` - Upload a receipt image or PDF

- operationId: `ingestReceipt`
- Requirements: REQ-RCPT-001

Multipart upload. Content type is sniffed server-side; only JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP and PDF are accepted. Duplicate images (same SHA-256 or perceptual hash) are reported as `DUPLICATE`.

Request body (`multipart/form-data`): `IngestReceiptForm`

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 202 | Raw message persisted; parsing continues asynchronously. | application/json: `IngestAccepted` |
| 400 | Malformed request or validation failure. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 413 | Body exceeds the configured size limit. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 415 | Unsupported media type after sniffing. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

### `POST /api/ingest/text` - Ingest free text (quick add)

- operationId: `ingestText`
- Requirements: REQ-PARSE-001

Same parser as WhatsApp text. Used by the Android quick-add widget, the PWA and the iOS Shortcut.

## Parsing

Side-effect-free parsing endpoints used by the eval harness and the "preview" UI.

### `POST /api/parse/dry-run` - Parse text without persisting anything

- operationId: `parseDryRun`
- Requirements: REQ-PARSE-001, REQ-PARSE-002

Runs normalisation, classification and extraction and returns the structured result.
No `raw_message` or `expense` is written, no reply is sent. Used by `eval/runners/run.py --adapter http`
and the "preview before saving" UI. Input is treated strictly as data (S10.5).

Request body (`application/json`): `ParseRequest`

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Structured parse result. | application/json: `ParseResult` |
| 400 | Malformed request or validation failure. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 413 | Body exceeds the configured size limit. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

## Webhooks

Inbound webhooks from the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.

### `GET /webhooks/whatsapp` - WhatsApp webhook verification handshake

- operationId: `verifyWhatsappWebhook`
- Requirements: REQ-WA-001
- Auth: none

Meta calls this once when the webhook URL is registered. Echoes `hub.challenge` when `hub.verify_token` matches.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hub.mode` | query | enum(subscribe) | yes |
| `hub.verify_token` | query | string | yes |
| `hub.challenge` | query | string | yes |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | The challenge, echoed verbatim. | text/plain: string |
| 403 | Authenticated but not allowed (wrong role or household). | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

### `POST /webhooks/whatsapp` - Receive WhatsApp events

- operationId: `receiveWhatsappWebhook`
- Requirements: REQ-WA-002, REQ-SEC-003
- Auth: none

Every request must carry a valid `X-Hub-Signature-256` (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the app secret).
The payload is persisted as a `raw_message` and `200` is returned within 1 s; processing is asynchronous.
Idempotent on the WhatsApp message ID (Meta retries).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `X-Hub-Signature-256` | header | string | yes |

Request body (`application/json`): `WhatsappWebhookPayload`

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Acknowledged (always, even for unknown senders, to stop retries). |  |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |
| 413 | Body exceeds the configured size limit. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

## Stream

Server-Sent Events so open apps update live.

### `GET /api/stream` - Live event stream (SSE)

- operationId: `streamEvents`
- Requirements: REQ-UI-001

`text/event-stream`. Each event has `event: <StreamEvent.type>`, `id: <StreamEvent.id>` and a JSON `data:` line
shaped like `StreamEvent`. Clients resume with `Last-Event-ID`. The server sends a `: ping` comment every 25 s.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Last-Event-ID` | header | string | no |

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | An open SSE stream. | text/event-stream: `StreamEvent` |
| 401 | Missing, expired or invalid credentials. | application/problem+json: `Problem` |

## Schemas

### Money

A monetary amount. `amountMinor` is an integer in the currency's minor unit (piastres, cents).
Never a float. Negative values are only used for refund deltas in analytics.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amountMinor` | integer (int64) | yes | Amount in minor units (EGP 12.50 = 1250). |
| `currency` | `CurrencyCode` | yes |  |

### CurrencyCode

ISO-4217 alphabetic code.

Type: string

### DecimalString

Exact decimal encoded as a string (used for FX rates and quantities so no float is ever transmitted).

Type: string

### NextCursor

Cursor for the next page, or `null` when this is the last page.

Type: string or null

### Problem

RFC 9457 problem details. Every 4xx/5xx body has this shape.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | string (uri) | yes | Problem type URI (`about:blank` for plain HTTP semantics). |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `status` | integer | yes |  |
| `detail` | string | no |  |
| `instance` | string (uri-reference) | no |  |
| `traceId` | string | no | Correlation id to find the request in logs. |
| `errors` | array of object | no | Field-level validation errors. |

### TransactionType

Type: enum(EXPENSE, INCOME, REFUND, TRANSFER, CASH_WITHDRAWAL)

### ExpenseStatus

Type: enum(CONFIRMED, PENDING_REVIEW, POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE, IGNORED)

### PaymentMethod

Type: enum(CASH, CARD, WALLET, INSTAPAY, BANK_TRANSFER, UNKNOWN)

### SplitMode

Type: enum(NONE, EQUAL, CUSTOM)

### MessageSource

Type: enum(WHATSAPP, SMS, PUSH, IOS_SHORTCUT, UPLOAD, MANUAL)

### ProcessingStatus

Type: enum(RECEIVED, QUEUED, PARSED, MATCHED, DONE, IGNORED, FAILED)

### SourceRole

Type: enum(PRIMARY, SUPPORTING)

### MemberRole

Type: enum(ADMIN, MEMBER)

### DevicePlatform

Type: enum(ANDROID, IOS_SHORTCUT, WEB)

### AccountType

Type: enum(CARD, BANK, WALLET, CASH)

### BudgetPeriod

Type: enum(MONTHLY, WEEKLY, CUSTOM)

### Cadence

Type: enum(WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, YEARLY, CUSTOM)

### SmsTemplateStatus

Type: enum(ACTIVE, PROPOSED, DISABLED)

### ReviewReason

Type: enum(PENDING_REVIEW, LOW_CONFIDENCE, POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE, NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, RULE_FORCED)

### ClassifiedType

Classifier output (§6 step 2). A superset of `TransactionType`.

Type: enum(EXPENSE, INCOME, REFUND, TRANSFER, CASH_WITHDRAWAL, COMMAND, OTP, PROMO, CHITCHAT, UNKNOWN)

### CommandName

Type: enum(TOTAL, CATEGORY_SPEND, UNDO, EDIT_LAST, BUDGET, PENDING, SUMMARY, HELP)

### Language

Type: enum(ar, en, mixed)

### WhatsappMode

Type: enum(GROUP, DIRECT)

### Health

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | enum(UP, DOWN) | yes |  |
| `version` | string | yes | Semantic version of the backend build. |
| `gitSha` | string | yes |  |
| `buildTime` | string (date-time) | yes |  |
| `time` | string (date-time) | yes | Server time now (UTC). |
| `checks` | object | no | Component checks. Only `db` exists until later stories add keys (for example `storage`, `queue`). |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `versionCode` | integer | yes |  |
| `versionName` | string | yes |  |

| `sha256` | string | yes |  |
| `changelog` | string | yes |  |
| `minSupportedVersionCode` | integer | no | Builds older than this must update before ingesting. |
